events.title: Export Control Escalation
events.description: Chip and model export controls tighten again. Either allied buyers keep access on volume licences while everyone else is cut off, or the controls are drawn so tightly that allies are rationed alongside adversaries – decide which at the time from the standing American posture and from what the Union has built.

events.title: Backlash Turns Physical
events.description: Protest against AI infrastructure moves from petitions and hearings to direct action: occupations at data centre sites, sabotage of grid connections, and in the harder cases injury. Policing it costs the Union more than the damage does.

portfolio.name: Launch the Critical Infrastructure Compute Shield
portfolio.description: Establish a legally mandated, EU-controlled compute tier for auditable AI in energy, health, and transport, with priority access during peak load and automatic fallback during incidents` — in flight

portfolio.name: Open Science Resilience Initiative
portfolio.description: Establish a pan-European network of public research institutes and open-weight developers focused on high-assurance, auditable AI systems for biosecurity, climate modelling, and critical infrastructure resilience, with guaranteed deployment pathways into EU agencies and member state operations

portfolio.name: Secure foundational resilience through joint threat response integration
portfolio.description: Embed EU systems into the new joint cyber-biosurveillance pact with real-time telemetry sharing, binding incident response protocols, and co-located analysis cells

new_measure: Mandate enforceable fallback to auditable AI in critical infrastructure
priority: Mandate enforceable fallback to auditable AI in critical infrastructure
